latestSnapshot.readme:
Infant FreeSurfer test subject (CNYBCH)
=======================================

This mprage dataset can be used to test FreeSurfer's infant pipeline.

Note that the subject age is recorded in years.  This should be converted to months when running the infant pipeline.

See:

  - https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/infantFS
  - https://doi.org/10.3389/fnhum.2015.00021
  - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2020.116946
